# hub-data

> Python tools for accessing and working with hubverse Hub data

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-data): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://hubverse-org.github.io/hub-data/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
